description: This Java class defines the DeleteResource command, which deletes a Resource from a PolicyEntry within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, and handles serialization and equality checks.

classes.name: DeleteResource
classes.description: A command class that deletes a Resource from a PolicyEntry, including JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, and string representation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a DeleteResource command with typed PolicyId, Label, ResourceKey, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a DeleteResource command from a JSON string or object.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the Label of the PolicyEntry to delete.

methods.name: getResourceKey
methods.description: Returns the ResourceKey of the Resource to delete.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the PolicyId of the Policy to which the Resource belongs.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path to the Resource to delete.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends command data to JSON payload for serialization.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is DELETE.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new DeleteResource command with updated headers.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Checks if another object can be equal to this instance.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code of the object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
